notes.title: UPDATE #2 - MAP2 Now available!
notes.content:

notes.title: UPDATE #1
notes.content:
[h1]Zhive v1.0.5   is now online![/h1]

Hello Everyone. A small but no less important update is now online.

[list]
[*]The gameover achievement should now be working properly.
[*]Fixed the collision of some areas where the soldiers could shoot tru the walls.
[*]Only the sounds closer to the camera will now be heard now.
[*]Fixed the music and sfx volume sliders.
[*]Very minor performance improvements
[/list]

And we continue working on the rest of the material in the bugs thread and the remaining maps.

Thanks!

notes.title: Zhive 1.0 is now available! - Incoming Day 1 update.
notes.content:
Zhive 1.0 is now available.

We hope you enjoy playing ZHive. As always, we are actively working on fixing some bugs that we could not fix in time, as well as tweaking the game to make it as fun, friendly and balanced as possible.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35407707/4df6f64990a004af78d21a23fd8e3e1ff5c02292.gif[/img]

Due to some development hardships, we could not finish map 2 and 3 in time, hence the 40% launch discount. But they are almost done, we hope to have them ready for you to play in less than a week.

If you find any bug, please don't hesitate to post it in the bugs thread. 

Thanks!
